findings.label: Supabase 415 message masks bucket config
findings.detail: A storage-side 415 (bytes already validated server-side) most likely means the bucket allow-list disagrees with the server, yet users see 'Format file harus PNG, JPG, GIF, atau WebP'. Consider a distinct message or keeping 500; the sanitized log still records it.

findings.label: GIF not covered end-to-end
findings.detail: Live verification covered PNG/JPEG/WebP only; GIF is unit-tested. Do a quick manual GIF upload if the bucket allow-list is uncertain.
